# Citaliarestauro

> > Citaliarestauro offers DGERT-certified online courses and educational resources in art history, heritage conservation, museology, and art appreciation.

Founded by Rute Ferreira in Portugal, Citaliarestauro provides professional training in art conservation, heritage education, and museum studies. The platform features courses on topics ranging from Impressionism and pigment history to preventive conservation practices, alongside educational articles exploring art movements, famous artists like Edgar Degas and Mary Cassatt, and cultural heritage sites.

## Key Topics

- Art History
- Heritage Education
- Art Conservation
- Impressionism
- Online Courses (DGERT-certified)
- Preventive Conservation
- Museum Education
- Pigment History
- Art Analysis
- Romanesque Architecture
- Art Market
- Iconography
- Educational Project Development
- Rota do Românico (Portugal)
- Mural Painting

## Online Courses & Training

- [Appreciation of Art - certificated courses](https://en.citaliarestauro.com/exhibition-and-appreciation-of-art): DGERT-certified courses on art appreciation, curating, and exhibitions
- [Teaching Art History for kids with 28 amusing activities](https://en.citaliarestauro.com/product/teaching-art-history-for-kids): Online course: teaching art history to children with 28 fun activities
- [History of Pigments in Art - online course](https://en.citaliarestauro.com/product/history-of-pigments-in-art): DGERT-certified course on pigments history from prehistory to present
- [Heritage and Museology Gift Voucher](https://en.citaliarestauro.com/product/voucher-heritage-and-museology): Gift voucher for Citaliarestauro heritage and museology online courses

## Conservation & Preservation Guides

- [Painting on canvas - what is the paint layer](https://en.citaliarestauro.com/chromatic-layer-in-a-painting-on-canvas): Technical guide to chromatic/pictorial layers in canvas paintings
- [Photo storage - 5 steps for a Preservation Program at home](https://en.citaliarestauro.com/photo-storage): 5-step guide for home photo preservation and archiving programs
- [Conservation of books | 5 simple actions: great results](https://en.citaliarestauro.com/conservation-of-books-and-documents): 5 essential preventive conservation actions for books and documents

## Heritage Education & Project Development

- [6 basic steps to build an Education for the Heritage project](https://en.citaliarestauro.com/education-for-the-heritage): Citaliarestauro's 6-step guide for heritage education at Rota do Românico

## Art History & Analysis

- [painting analysis | watch some of our videos](https://en.citaliarestauro.com/painting-analysis): Video collection analyzing Van Gogh's Starry Night and other paintings
- [Interpreting art - Join us in a reflexion about this theme](https://en.citaliarestauro.com/interpreting-art-a-reflexion): Reflection on art interpretation using Velázquez's El Aguador de Sevilla
- [Discover the Color Symbolism in Religions](https://en.citaliarestauro.com/color-symbolism-in-religions): Color symbolism across religions from Aboriginal Wandjina to manuscripts

## Impressionism & Artists

- [Childhood in the work of Lilla Cabot Perry](https://en.citaliarestauro.com/childhood-in-the-work-of-lilla-cabot-perry): American Impressionist Lilla Cabot Perry's childhood portrait paintings
